root_cause.text: The `rb_read_data_buffer()` function in the tracing ring-buffer subsystem fails to validate the event length retrieved from a potentially corrupted ring buffer before using it to calculate the offset of the next event, leading to out-of-bounds memory access.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds a validation check `if (len <= 0 || len > tail - e)` in `kernel/trace/ring_buffer.c` to ensure the event length is within the possible range before updating the buffer index `e`.
